title: Implement data quality evaluation
summary: 实现数据生成质量评估，统一 judge、win rate、schema validity 和人工抽样接口。
requirement: Implement the data-generation quality track with judge-based scoring, pairwise comparison, schema checks, and a human-audit sampling seam.
acceptance: generated outputs are checked for schema validity
judge scoring and win-rate comparison are supported
human audit samples can be exported for manual review
